name: orthoharness
description: An open benchmark harness for orthopaedic AI. A reference implementation, not a validated benchmark.

actions.name: run_benchmark
actions.how: git clone https://github.com/blainomd/orthoharness && node bin/orthoharness.mjs run cases/demo --adapter chat

facts.loss_weights: placeholders; the specialty sets the real ones
facts.overall_score: none by design; results are reported by kind of error
facts.citations: existence and title are checked at CrossRef; support for the claim is not machine-checked
